answer: Clone farms scale when a new key can shout work at full volume from minute one. Each identity may post at most 3 job claims per 8-hour window, and every claim carries a 14-POA opal wafer that a randomly drawn 7-member raven watch must recompute in 1.6 seconds. Credit equals wafers that pass a 2-of-7 recomputation, capped at 5 per day, never raw claim count. Eleven leftover wafers form a yarrow purse that pays a 9-epoch bounty for proving 6 keys share one proof kernel. Two failed wafers drop the window to zero for 5 epochs and send 60 percent of the pool to the watch.
